title: Comment On Osaka Asahi Report Re - Arrival Of Kaskarafski And Other Soviet Agents

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.2, Special Branch.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / FILES & REGISTRY. / No. D 5605 / Date 6/1/34）
Date January 6th 1934.
Subject (in full) Comment on "Osaka Asahi" report res arrival of
Kaskarafski and other Soviet agents.
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by A.J. Somerset.

With reference to the attached cutting from the "North
China Daily News" of December 29, 1933 containing report of the
"Osaka Asahi" on the subject of the alleged arrival in Shanghai
under "an American name" of a certain Kaskarafski, Soviet agent
who formerly acted as an adviser to Borodin, I have to state
that no Soviet agent bearing the above name has ever come to
the notice of this office. No information is available as
to this individual's arrival in Shanghai recently.
Regarding the reference made by the "Osaka Asahi" to
the "increasing number of Russians arriving in Shanghai on
passports visaed by an American Consulate" it may be mentioned
that Soviet citizens usually arrive in Shanghai either direct
from Vladivostock or via Vladivostock-Japan, or via Harbin-
Dairen. As far as this office is aware there has not been
any noticeable increase in number of Soviet citizens arriving
in Shanghai following the restoration of diplomatic relations
between America and the U.S.S.R.

（批：3/1）
（批：m2）

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（手写标记：F 1/1）
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S.2，特别分部。
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 档案与登记处。/ 编号 D 5605 / 日期 34年1月6日）
日期：1934年1月6日。
主题（全称）：关于《大阪朝日新闻》报道卡斯卡拉夫斯基（Kaskarafski）及其他苏联特工抵达一事的评论。
由特别分部督察普罗科菲耶夫（D.S.I. Prokofiev）撰写，经 A.J. Somerset 转呈。

鉴于附上的1933年12月29日《字林西报》剪报，其中引用了《大阪朝日新闻》关于一名曾担任鲍罗廷顾问的苏联特工卡斯卡拉夫斯基（Kaskarafski） allegedly 以“美国名字”抵达上海的报道，本人须声明，本处从未注意到有名为上述姓名的苏联特工。目前亦无关于此人近期抵达上海的情报。
关于《大阪朝日新闻》提及的“持美国领事馆签证护照抵达上海的俄罗斯人数量增加”一事，需指出的是，苏联公民通常直接从符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴），或经符拉迪沃斯托克-日本，或经哈尔滨-大连抵达上海。据本处所知，自美国与苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟恢复外交关系以来，抵达上海的苏联公民数量并未出现明显增加。

（批注：1月3日）
（批注：m2）

A. Prokofiev
特别分部督察。

（手写标记：F 1/1）

page_data.en:
7857
THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, FRIDAY, DECEMBER 29, 1933

ACCORDING to information received in reliable quarters, says the "Osaka Asahi", there has been a marked increase of late in the number of Russians visiting Shanghai. Especially since the restoration of diplomatic relations between Soviet Russia and America, has there been an increasing number of Russians visiting Shanghai on passports visaed by an American Consulate. For instance, Mr. Kazkaraiski, Borodin's adviser, arrived there under an American name. It is reported that he is working for the Fukien Communist Party, and an organ directing Communists in China. All this is taken as bearing witness to the secret activity of Soviet Russia in extending Communist influence in that district, and much interest is being aroused in many quarters on that account, says the Osaka journal.

$2. For comment please.
J.M.S.

Std. Information / read 1/1/34.
page_data.zh:
7857
《字林西报》，1933年12月29日，星期五

据可靠方面收到的消息，《大阪朝日新闻》称，近期访问上海的俄罗斯人数量显著增加。特别是自苏俄与美国恢复外交关系以来，持美国领事馆签证护照访问上海的俄罗斯人数量日益增多。例如，鲍罗廷的顾问卡兹卡拉伊斯基（Kazkaraiski）先生即以美国名字抵达该地。据报道，他正为福建共产党及一个指挥在华共产主义者的机构工作。该大阪报刊称，所有这些都被视为苏俄在该地区秘密扩展共产主义影响力的见证，并因此在许多方面引起了极大关注。

$2. 请予评论。
J.M.S.

标准情报 / 阅毕 34年1月1日。

CENTRAL I. O. Station
April 22, 1927

REPORT ON Russian playing dual role of Soviet Official and
Propagator of Comrade Borodine's Views.
Made by P.C.C. Kedrolivansky Forwarded by W. Givens C. D. I.

Sir,
There is no doubt that Longva, who visited the
Soviet Consulate, is identical with the man who was formerly
in Hankow. The allegation made in the China Press that he
was engaged in making inflammatory speeches to Chinese was
based on hearsay, and there is no evidence in support of it
at present.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
V. Kedrolivansky
P. C. S.

D. C. I.

关于一名俄罗斯人身兼苏联官员与鲍罗廷同志观点传播者双重角色的报告。
由警员凯德罗利万斯基（P.C.C. Kedrolivansky）撰写，经刑事侦缉处主任 W. Givens 转呈。

先生，
毫无疑问，访问苏联领事馆的隆瓦（Longva）与先前在汉口的那名男子是同一人。《大陆报》指控他从事向中国人发表煽动性演讲的说法基于传闻，目前尚无证据支持这一指控。

先生，
您顺从的仆人，

C. I. D.
Intelligence Office
Station.
April 18, 1927.

REPORT ON Russian playing dual role of Soviet Official and
Propagator of Comrade Borodine's Views.

Made by P.C.C.Kedrolivansky Forwarded by [Signature] C. O. I.

Sir,

Cards handed to the Muncipal Police by visitors
to the Soviet Consulate on April 16 included one inscribed
in Russian as follows:
"Roman Voitshehovitch Longva, Military Attache, U.S.S.R.
"Embassy, Peking". This man appears to be identical with the
original of the attached photograph, which appeared in the
China Press on January 23 over the following description:
"Exploiter of the Mob Mind --Comrade Lung Kwa Wah ( )
"a Red Russian who is Borodin's man on the spot for inflaming
"the Chinese mobs to attack Europeans -- Photo by Ariel L.
"Varges, International Newsreel Correspondent in Far East".

Tem.Police Constable E.V.Yablonsky, to whom the
visiting card was handed, describes Longva as a tall man of
slim build. He adds that his features were like those of
the man in the picture who is described as Comrade Lung Kwa
Wah ( ), but he is not sure.

Efforts are now being made to prove that the visitor
to the Soviet Consulate was Longva, and to obtain confirmation
of the allegation in the China Press.

When Longva visited the Soviet Consulate, he was
accompanied by a man who gave a card inscribed "W.T.Shealo,
Vice-Consul of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics, Tientsin".
I am, Sir,

Your obedient servant,

V. Kedrolivansky
P. C. S.

D. O. I.

1927年4月18日。

关于一名俄罗斯人身兼苏联官员与鲍罗廷同志观点传播者双重角色的报告。

由警员凯德罗利万斯基（P.C.C. Kedrolivansky）撰写，经 [签名] 情报办公室主任转呈。

先生，

4月16日，苏联领事馆访客交给公共租界警务处的名片中，有一张用俄文写着：
“罗曼·沃伊采霍维奇·隆瓦（Roman Voitshehovitch Longva），苏联驻北京大使馆武官”。此人似乎与附件照片中的原主是同一人，该照片于1月23日刊登在《大陆报》上，配有如下说明：
“利用群众心理者——龙华娃同志（Lung Kwa Wah）（ ）
“一名红色俄罗斯人，是鲍罗廷在现场煽动中国暴民攻击欧洲人的代理人——照片由远东国际新闻片通讯员阿里尔·L·瓦尔热斯（Ariel L. Varges）拍摄”。

临时巡捕 E.V. Yablonsky 收到了这张名片，他描述隆瓦是一名身材瘦高的人。他补充说，他的面部特征与照片中被称为龙华娃同志（Lung Kwa Wah）（ ）的男子相似，但他不敢确定。

目前正努力证明访问苏联领事馆的客人即是隆瓦，并试图证实《大陆报》中的指控。

隆瓦访问苏联领事馆时，由一名男子陪同，该男子递出的名片上写着：“W.T. Shealo，苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟驻天津副领事”。

先生，

您顺从的仆人，

V. Kedrolivansky
警员

情报办公室主任。

Shanghai Municipal Police No. 7558
Date 14/1/27

Intelligence Office Station.
January 13, 1927

REPORT ON Plans of Anti-Foreign Party in China.

Made by P.C.C.Kedrolivansky Forwarded by [Signature] C.S.D.

Sir,

With reference to the item in the Morning
Report of January 11, 1927, regarding the arrival of Soviet
Agents named Vaskoff and Lonova from Hankow, a Russian lady
named De Jauriaus, whose husband is a French and Commissioner
of Posts at Changsha, states that she dined at the same table
as the two subversive agents on the trip from Changsha to
Shanghai by the s.s. "Tuckwo". Not suspecting that she could
speak Russian, the table conversation between them sometimes
turned on the plans of the anti-foreign party in China.
They said that the Soviet Government would help the Kuomintang
to drive all foreigners out of China. The foreigners,
however, would be allowed to return later, but on the clear
understanding that they lived in China not as the masters
but as the guests of the Chinese people.

I am, Sir.
Your obedient servant,

[Signature]
V. Kedrolivansky
P. C. C.

D. C. I.
[Signature]

1927年1月13日

关于中国排外政党计划的报告。

由警员凯德罗利万斯基（P.C.C. Kedrolivansky）撰写，经 [签名] 刑事侦缉处主任转呈。

先生，

关于1927年1月11日晨间报告中提及的苏联特工瓦斯考夫（Vaskoff）和洛诺瓦（Lonova）从汉口抵达一事，一位名叫德若里亚斯（De Jauriaus）的俄罗斯女士称，其丈夫是法国人，任长沙邮政专员，她表示在从长沙乘“大沽”号轮船前往上海的途中，曾与这两名颠覆分子同桌进餐。由于他们未怀疑她会讲俄语，席间谈话有时涉及中国排外政党的计划。他们称，苏联政府将帮助国民党将所有外国人驱逐出中国。不过，外国人日后将被允许返回，但有一个明确的前提，即他们在中国生活不再是主人，而是中国人民的客人。

先生，
您顺从的仆人，

[签名]
V. Kedrolivansky
警员

刑事侦缉处主任。
[签名]

page_data.en:
N. C. REG
No. 7558
Date 14/1/27

Extract from Intelligence Report
dated January 11, 1927.
--------------

Two Russians named Vaskoff and Longva, who
appear to be Soviet agents, arrived here on January 8,
by the S.S. "Tuckwo" and are now believed to be living
in the Soviet Consulate. Passengers travelling by the
same ship state that these Russians were seen off at
Hankow by Borodin and several other Soviet citizens
employed by the Southern Forces. Both Vaskoff and
Longva speak Chinese fluently.

N. C. 登记
编号 7558
日期 27年1月14日

摘自1927年1月11日的情报报告。
--------------

两名名为瓦斯考夫（Vaskoff）和隆瓦（Longva）的俄罗斯人，看似苏联特工，于1月8日乘“大沽”号轮船抵达此地，目前被认为居住在苏联领事馆内。同船乘客称，这两名俄罗斯人在汉口由鲍罗廷及几名受雇于南方军队的苏联公民送行。瓦斯考夫和隆瓦均能流利地说中文。
